parts.plan_in_words: From forecast row records; keep rows where forecasts.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' and day(forecasts.date) between 2026-06-01 and 2026-06-28; report forecast_units_june = sum of forecasts.forecast_units_per_day, forecast_days = count distinct of day(forecasts.date).

parts.covers: Demand is not recorded and lost sales are not recorded (forecast_vs_demand); recorded June units sold are only a labelled stand-in, so the 13% premise and any tune-down can be checked against sales, not true shopper demand.
parts.sql: select sum("daily-sales-june"."units_sold") as "recorded_units_june", count(distinct substr("daily-sales-june"."date",1,10)) as "sales_days" from "daily-sales-june"  where ("daily-sales-june"."sku" = ?) and (substr(substr("daily-sales-june"."date",1,10),1,10) between ? and ?) limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From daily sales row records; keep rows where daily sales.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' and day(daily sales.date) between 2026-06-01 and 2026-06-28; report recorded_units_june = sum of daily sales.units_sold, sales_days = count distinct of day(daily sales.date).

parts.covers: Checks the premise that no 5 kg atta bags sold on 2026-06-11; daily sales are whole-day totals, so afternoon-only sales are not recorded.
parts.sql: select "daily-sales-june"."units_sold" as "units_sold", "daily-sales-june"."revenue_inr" as "revenue_inr" from "daily-sales-june"  where ("daily-sales-june"."sku" = ?) and (substr(substr("daily-sales-june"."date",1,10),1,10) = ?) limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From daily sales row records; keep rows where daily sales.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' and day(daily sales.date) = '2026-06-11'; report units_sold = daily sales.units_sold, revenue_inr = daily sales.revenue_inr.

parts.covers: Checks the stated 2.3 days of supply on 2026-06-11 using book stock divided by the recorded daily forecast; book stock is a belief, not shelf availability.
parts.sql: select "forecasts-june"."book_on_hand" as "book_on_hand", "forecasts-june"."forecast_units_per_day" as "forecast_units_per_day", ("forecasts-june"."book_on_hand" * 1.0 / nullif("forecasts-june"."forecast_units_per_day", 0)) as "days_of_supply" from "forecasts-june"  where ("forecasts-june"."sku" = ?) and (substr(substr("forecasts-june"."date",1,10),1,10) = ?) limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From forecast row records; keep rows where forecasts.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' and day(forecasts.date) = '2026-06-11'; report book_on_hand = forecasts.book_on_hand, forecast_units_per_day = forecasts.forecast_units_per_day, days_of_supply = forecasts.book_on_hand / forecasts.forecast_units_per_day.

parts.covers: Uses the nearest 11:00 shelf audits as evidence of on-shelf availability around 2026-06-11; these snapshots do not establish afternoon shelf status or hours off shelf.

parts.plan_in_words: From shelf-audit row records; keep rows where shelf audits.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' and day(shelf audits.audit_ts) between 2026-06-09 and 2026-06-12; report audit_ts = shelf audits.audit_ts, status = shelf audits.status; sorted by audit_ts asc.

parts.plan_in_words: From warehouse (DC) stock adjustment records; inner-join product records on dc stock adjustments.sku = products.sku; keep rows where dc stock adjustments.sku in ['ATTA-WW-10KG', 'ATTA-WW-1KG', 'ATTA-WW-5KG']; group by dc stock adjustments.sku, dc stock adjustments.slot, dc stock adjustments.reason; report sku = dc stock adjustments.sku, slot = dc stock adjustments.slot, reason = dc stock adjustments.reason, adjustment_rows = count of *, units_changed = sum of dc stock adjustments.units, gross_value_at_cost_inr = sum of abs(dc stock adjustments.value_at_cost_inr), net_value_at_cost_inr = sum of dc stock adjustments.value_at_cost_inr, first_adjusted_ts = min of dc stock adjustments.adjusted_ts, last_adjusted_ts = max of dc stock adjustments.adjusted_ts; sorted by sku asc, slot asc.
